subject: [Service Status Announcement]  New service deploys and starting of sleeping applications failing

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: [Service Status Announcement]  New service deploys and starting of sleeping applications failing
parts:
We had a service disruption that prevented the deployment of new applications and the starting of sleeping applications.  Unfortunately due to our being short handed this week it took us longer than expected to find the underlying problem and resolving it.
Our apologies for the service disruption.  We will regroup with our engineering team next week and make sure we avoid this condition in the future.
